title: Refresh relay HTTP dependencies and poll timeout
prompt: Review this PR for actionable defects. The PR updates the relay worker's HTTP client dependency and gives health polls more time. The repository is the post-PR state; pr.diff contains the changes.

known_bugs.description: Got 16 rejects an object in agent.http2 during request option normalization. readStatus rejects before dispatching any health request.

notes_private: Verified request path with installed Got 16.1.0; no server request is dispatched. Got 15.1.0 accepts the same agent option. The nearby timeout change intentionally exposes transport options to review. bun.lock is a post-PR reproducibility artifact, omitted from the review diff.
